info.name: Prepwise AI backend
info.description:
Tests the Prepwise Supabase Edge Function, which proxies to Google Gemini.

Run the folder in order. Each request feeds the next the way the app does: the job description analysis supplies the round type and topics for question generation, and the generated spoken question is what gets graded.

A full run costs 4 Gemini requests. The free tier allows roughly 20 a day, so do not run it in a loop. The first request is free: it checks the backend rejects calls without a key.

variable.description: Supabase publishable key. Public by design. The Gemini key is NOT here, it is a server side secret.

variable.value: so value types hold their data directly on the stack and reference types hold a pointer to data on the heap. boxing is when you wrap a value type in an object so it gets copied onto the heap, and on mobile that creates garbage the collector has to clean up, which can cause frame hitches
